When the sky splits and the earth is stretched out and casts out its contents, obeying its Lord, mankind is told it labors toward its Lord and will meet it.
Whoever gets his record in his right hand has an easy account and returns happy; whoever gets it behind his back burns, having thought he would never return.
By the twilight, night and full moon, people will pass from state to state; yet disbelievers do not believe or prostrate at the Quran, and face punishment, unlike righteous believers.
Cursed were the companions of the fiery trench, who witnessed what they did to the believers, resenting them only for believing in Allah; unrepentant torturers face Hell, believers gardens.
Allah's vengeance is severe; He originates and repeats, and He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate, the honorable Owner of the Throne, doing whatever He intends.
The story of the soldiers of Pharaoh and Thamud is recalled, yet disbelievers persist in denial while Allah encompasses them.
This is an honored Quran inscribed in a Preserved Slate.
By the sky and the piercing star, every soul has a protector; Allah can return man, created from an ejected fluid, on the Day secrets are put on trial.
By the sky that returns rain and the earth that cracks open, the Quran is a decisive word, not amusement; the disbelievers plot, Allah plots, so give them time.
Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High, who created and proportioned, destined and guided, and brings out pasture then turns it to black stubble.
Allah will make the Prophet recite so he does not forget, except as Allah wills, and will ease him toward ease.
Remind, for whoever fears Allah takes heed while the wretched avoid it and burn in the greatest Fire; whoever purifies himself, remembers his Lord's name and prays succeeds.
People prefer worldly life though the Hereafter is better and more lasting, as stated in the former scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
On the Overwhelming Day some faces will be humbled and weary, burning in a hot Fire, drinking from a boiling spring and eating a thorny plant that does not nourish.
Other faces will be joyful, pleased with their effort, in an elevated garden free of unsuitable speech, with a flowing spring, raised couches, cups, cushions and spread carpets.
People are asked to look at how camels are created, the sky raised, the mountains set up and the earth spread out.
The Prophet is only a reminder, not a controller; Allah will punish whoever turns away and disbelieves, for their return and account are with Him.
By the dawn and ten nights, Allah dealt with 'Aad of Iram, Thamud who carved rocks, and Pharaoh of the stakes, who spread corruption, pouring punishment upon them.
Man thinks Allah's generosity honors him and restricted provision humiliates him, yet people neglect the orphan and feeding the poor, devour inheritance and love wealth intensely.
When the earth is crushed, the Lord comes with angels in ranks and Hell is brought near, man will remember too late, wishing he had sent good ahead.
The reassured soul is told to return to its Lord, pleased and pleasing, and enter among His servants into His Paradise.
By this city, Makkah, man is created into hardship; he boasts of wealth spent as if unseen, though Allah gave him eyes, tongue and lips and showed him two ways.
The difficult pass is freeing a slave or feeding an orphaned relative or a needy person on a day of hunger, then being among believers who urge patience and compassion.
Such believers are the companions of the right, while those who disbelieve in Allah's signs are the companions of the left, with fire closed over them.
By the sun, moon, day, night, sky, earth and the soul inspired with its wickedness and righteousness, whoever purifies the soul succeeds and whoever corrupts it fails.
Thamud rejected their messenger, Salih, and hamstrung Allah's she-camel he warned them about, so their Lord destroyed them all for their sin.
By night, day and the creation of male and female, efforts differ: whoever gives and fears Allah is eased toward ease, the stingy denier toward difficulty, his wealth no help.
Allah has taken upon Himself to show guidance, and to Him belong the Hereafter and the first life.
Allah warns of a blazing Fire in which only the most wretched, who denied and turned away, will burn.
The righteous one, who gives his wealth to purify himself, repaying no favor but seeking only his Lord's countenance, will be kept from the Fire and be satisfied.
Allah has not left the Prophet; He sheltered him as an orphan, guided and enriched him, so he must not oppress orphans or repel petitioners, and must report His favor.
Allah expanded the Prophet's breast, lifted his burden and raised his repute; with hardship comes ease, so after finishing, stand up in worship and long for your Lord.
By the fig, olive, Mount Sinai and this secure city, man is created in the best stature then returned to the lowest, except righteous believers; Allah judges most justly.
The first revelation: recite in the name of your Lord, who created man from a clinging substance and, most Generous, taught by the pen what man did not know.
Man transgresses when he sees himself self-sufficient, yet to his Lord is the return.
Abu Jahl, who forbids a servant from praying and turns away, will be dragged by his lying forelock unless he stops; do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near.
Allah sent down the Quran on the Night of Decree, better than a thousand months, when the angels and the Spirit descend, and it is peace until dawn.

Disbelievers among the People of the Scripture and polytheists would not leave disbelief until clear evidence came, a Messenger reciting purified scriptures, though commanded only to worship Allah sincerely.
Disbelievers among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists abide in Hell, the worst of creatures, while righteous believers, the best of creatures, abide in gardens, pleased with Allah.
When the earth quakes, throws out its burdens and reports its news, people come forth in groups to see their deeds, every atom's weight of good or evil.
